SugarGroveMissileSiloExt |refid ={{ID|0026187c}} |crafting ={{Crafting stations FO76 |brewing =yes }} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMountain}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeOutdoors}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} |edid =SubMountainsYellowSandysStillLocation }} '''Yellow Sandy's still''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Savage Divide]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== Yellow Sandy's still was used by the [[Raiders (Fallout 76)|raiders]] of Appalachia to brew a variety of alcoholic beverages. However, it seems one raider, [[Frank (Cutthroats)|Frank]], experimented a bit too much with the recipe, earning the ire of one of the raiders.[[For Frank]] ==Layout== Yellow Sandy's still is a small island to the northeast of the [[Central Mountain Lookout]]. It is accessible via a shoddy wooden bridge that is rigged with a tripwire, spike trap, and a [[Bear trap (Fallout 76)|bear trap]]. The entire island is booby trapped along the shoreline. Towards the center of the area there are two trailers and a truck, filled with [[moonshine jug]]s and [[containment barrel]]s. On top of the northern trailer is a [[Campmaster 2000]] grill. The island is also the site of a [[Fallout 76 random encounters|random encounter]] where two scientists may appear. There is a [[brewing station]] located under the awning of one of the trailers. Along the shoreline are several [[jetski]]s, inner tubes, and [[inflatable raft]]s. ==Notable loot== * [[For Frank]] - Note, on a table outside of the eastern trailer door. * Potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] - On the roof of the eastern trailer, on the 2x4s connecting the trailer to the tree. * Potential [[Fallout 76 perk magazines|magazine]] - Inside the eastern rusty caravan trailer with the [[Nuka-Cola machine (Fallout 4)|Nuka-Cola machine]] inside it, on the small green card table with the [[TV dinner tray (Fallout 76)|TV dinner tray]]. ==Appearances== Yellow Sandy's still appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== FO76 Yellow Sandys 5.png FO76 Yellow Sandys 4.png FO76 Yellow Sandys 3.png FO76 Yellow Sandys 2.png FO76 Yellow Sandys 1.png FO76 Yellow Sandys 6.png FO76 Yellow Sandys 7.png FO76 Yellow Sandys 8.png FO76 2121 Sandy still 1.png FO76 Sign I cant read.png FO76 Sandy still in a radstorm.png ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:Savage Divide locations]] [[ru:Винокурня Сэнди]] [[zh:黃色珊迪的酒廠]] [[uk:Перегінний цех «Жовті піски»]]

[[Charleston Station]] |sections = |buildings = |doctors = |leaders = |merchants =* [[Vendor bot Raider]] * [[Ammunition vending machine]] * [[Medical supplies vending machine|Medical supplies vending]] * [[Legendary exchange machine]] |owners = |factions =[[Gourmands]] (formerly) |robots = |quests = |terminal =[[Sutton Station terminal entries|Sutton Station information]] |cell name =* POITrainStationSuttonExt * POITrainStationSuttonExt02 |formid =* {{ID|002634c2}} |crafting ={{Crafting stations FO76 |chems =yes }} |keywords = * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionForestFloodlands}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScalePOI}} |editor id =SubForestSuttonTrainStationLocation }} '''Sutton Station''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|train station]] in [[the Forest]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== Situated up a hill on the southern outskirts of [[Sutton]], the facility consists of a track-side platform and station building along the Red Line. The location provided ancillary services such as a staffed ticket sales counter and automated ticket machines before the [[Great War]]. A part of the long-defunct network of [[Fallout 76 railways#Train stations|train stations]] across Appalachia, it was re-appropriated by the [[Raiders (Fallout 76)|raiders]] and set up as a hub for operations and trade via [[vendor bot Raider|vendor bot]]. ==Layout== Outdoor seating can be found around the station's exterior, with many [[Beer bottle (Fallout 76)|beer bottles]] on and around the tables. There is an [[ammunition vending machine]], [[medical supplies vending machine]], [[punch card machine]], and [[legendary exchange machine]] sitting on the platform. Inside, a [[My stash box|stash box]] sits in front of the shop counter. There is also a [[Chemistry station (Fallout 76)|chemistry station]] near some lockers and a bottle of [[waste acid]] or [[waste antiseptic]] can spawn on a table near them. The toilet in the bathroom contains three rolls of [[toilet paper]]. ==Notable loot== * [[The Herald supports Quinn Carter]] - Note, in a locker along the western wall on the top shelf. ==Notes== As of the ''[[Locked & Loaded]]'' update, a [[punch card machine]] was added to all [[Fallout 76 railways#Train_stations|train stations]]. ==Appearances== Sutton Station appears in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== F76 Sutton Station 1.png|Side view F76 Sutton Station 2.png|Other side Fo76 Sutton Station Interior North.png|Interior facing north Fo76 Sutton Station Interior South.png|Interior facing south FO76 Sutton Station exterior 4.png FO76 Sutton Station exterior 3.png FO76 Sutton Station exterior 2.png FO76 Sutton Station exterior 1.png FO76 Sutton Station exterior 7.png FO76 Sutton Station exterior 6.png FO76 Sutton Station exterior 5.png ;''Post-Locked & Loaded'' FO76 Train station perk 2.png FO76 Train station int 7.png FO76 Train station int 8.png {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Sutton]] [[Category:Fallout 76 raider theme locations]] [[Category:Fallout 76 railway locations]] [[ru:Станция Саттон]] [[zh:薩頓站]]

She appears after completing [[Secrets Revealed]]. ==Background== {{Quotation|Get on the bad side of the Raiders at Crater or the Settlers of Foundation? Rumor has it someone at the Wayward might be able to help you out...|[[Fallout 76 loading screens]]}} Cherise arrived at the Wayward at some point in [[Timeline#2103|2103]]. She claims to have many contacts around Appalachia, and offers her services to [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault 76 Dwellers]] to help improve their relations with [[the Crater]] or [[Foundation]] if they ever get on their wrong side.Cherise: ''"If Foundation or Crater is ever gunning for you, hit me up.
